column3: Close to the Hebrew; “buy grain” is rendered “buy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “weigh out” is rendered “spend,” “toil” “wages,” and “fatness” “abundance.”
Close to the Hebrew; חַסְדֵי (hasdei) is rendered “The sure mercies of.”
Close to the Hebrew; “peoples” is rendered “the people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a person of wickedness” is rendered “the unrighteous man,” and “increase to forgive” “abundantly pardon.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in vain” (empty) is rendered “void.”
Close to the Hebrew; “clap a palm” is rendered “clap their hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “nettle” is rendered “brier.”
